description: This file contains unit tests for the MacPort class in the webkitpy.layout_tests.port module, testing various methods related to build paths, operating system info, driver paths, image diff paths, and Apache config paths.

classes.name: MacPortTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the MacPort class functionalities.

methods.name: assert_name
methods.description: Tests that the port's name matches the expected value.

methods.name: test_operating_system
methods.description: Verifies that the operating system reported by the port is 'mac'.

methods.name: test_build_path
methods.description: Tests the logic for determining the build path based on options.

methods.name: test_build_path_timestamps
methods.description: Checks that the build path selection prefers the newer directory based on timestamps.

methods.name: test_driver_name_option
methods.description: Verifies the driver path ends with the expected driver name.

methods.name: test_path_to_image_diff
methods.description: Checks the path to the image diff tool.

methods.name: test_path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Verifies the path to the Apache configuration file based on version.
